title: IRS Transcript Failure Rate
dataSources: TurboTax returns (`turbotax:return`), IRS transcripts (`irs:transcript`), tax estimates (`tax:estimate`), tax payments (`tax:payment`), and W-2 imports (`w2:import`).
app: TurboTax return exports, IRS transcript pulls, tax estimate calculators, payment confirmations, and W-2 import logs ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=irs:transcript
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(transcript_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by transcript_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often IRS transcript records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each transcript type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize transcript_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per transcript type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your IRS transcript data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
